Ordering takes one WhatsApp message.

  1. Add pieces to your bag

    Each item is a single piece. Adding it doesn't hold it, so send your order soon.

  2. Send the order on WhatsApp

    Your bag turns into a ready-made message with every item, size and the total.

  3. We confirm and deliver

    We reply to confirm your pieces, then arrange delivery or pickup.

Delivery

Across Qatar. Doha orders arrive within 24 hours. The fee is added to your order.

Payment

Cash on delivery or bank transfer. We share details when we confirm.

Sizing

Vintage sizes run differently. Every piece lists flat measurements in cm.
